findings.detail: Warrants with fair value 387 thousand are present in the source schedule but absent from the extracted fair value sum.
Short-term investments with fair value 28,518 thousand are present in the source schedule but absent from the extracted fair value sum.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate conservation check. The filing schedule total and companyfacts anchor are both 183,056,000, while the extracted fair value sum is 154,151,000. The 28,905,000 residual localizes exactly to source subtotals for warrants (387,000) and short-term investments (28,518,000), so the flag reflects omitted source investments rather than a bad anchor.
